title: PEACE IN ADVENT
A PRAYER FOR YOUR HOME
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp lit wooden table with open holy bible during advent season
cozy dim lit living room with warm candle light and olive branches
peaceful snow covered cottage window with warm light inside at twilight
dark cozy room illuminated by warm candlelight on open scripture
cozy kitchen table with warm lamp light and bible open to gospels
peaceful rustic home living room bathed in warm glow of advent candle

scenes.a: Your silent worry this Advent has an answer.
But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a dream, saying,
scenes.sub: THE ANGEL OF THE LORD APPEARED

scenes.a: Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
Lord, in this season of waiting, quiet the doubts that trouble our home. Cover our family with Your promise, and remind us that You came to save.
scenes.sub: QUIET THE DOUBTS IN OUR HOME
